scenario: A failure before the first authority migration
injected: a live query holds AccessShareLock on agents; 0019 cannot take ACCESS EXCLUSIVE and hits lock_timeout
operator_action: none. The database is still at the deployed revision and nothing partial was applied; retry the pre-deploy migration in a quieter window.

injected: 0019/0020 applied; a live query holds AccessShareLock on audit_logs; 0021's unique constraint hits lock_timeout
operator_action: none, and NO downgrade. Each migration commits or rolls back as a whole, so the database sits at the last completed revision with a consistent schema. The partially applied authority tables are inert to the old application. Retry forward.

scenario: C schema migrated, old application still serving
injected: the pre-deploy migration succeeded; the application rollout has not happened yet
operator_action: none. This is the normal pre-deploy window and the old application is unaffected -- proved by running the deployed branch's own suite against this database with an identical pass/fail set. Roll the application forward when ready.

scenario: D application rolled back after the database reached head
injected: the new application was deployed and then rolled back; the database stays at 0027
operator_action: roll the application back and leave the database forward. Alembic downgrade is NOT the recovery mechanism -- 0023-0027 raise NotImplementedError on downgrade by design. Recovery is either (1) deploy the previous application image, which the old-app/new-db result shows is safe, or (2) restore from a snapshot taken before the pre-deploy migration, which loses everything written since. (1) is the expected path; (2) is only for a schema fault that a reviewed forward migration cannot repair.
